rule: Company-stated Chinese names only: the company's own Taiwan registration in the Ministry of Economic Affairs company registry (GCIS open data; the cited query returns the registered name and, where shown, the parent shareholder), its official Chinese website or press release. The registered name is shown without the foreign-company prefix (美商, 新加坡商, 香港商, 英屬維京群島商), the locality prefix (台灣) and the legal-form suffix. Entries fill gaps where Chinese Wikipedia has no Chinese title; no translation and no media transliteration. Entries with "source": "ZHWIKI" give the zh-tw display title of the company's Chinese Wikipedia article where the automatic Wikidata listing match misses it (a spin-off whose article sits on the predecessor item) or shows a different label; they override the name cache at seal time. A Japanese company's own kanji name on its official site counts as company-stated.
